# Open Questions

- `Tease:` Unknowns stay visible instead of becoming guesses.
- `Lede:` This document records unresolved product, architecture, data, and
  operational questions with an evidence-backed resolution path.
- `Why it matters:`
  - Plausible assumptions are a common source of agent drift.
  - Blocking questions should be distinguishable from useful later research.
- `Go deeper:`
  - Move resolved decisions into the appropriate plan, specification, or ADR.
